sync_fifo.timing_basis: One rising edge per operation; fill and drain four entries, reject empty/full operations and repeat pointer wrap. Simultaneously accepted read/write preserves occupancy. The 2026-10-04 count correction changes both RTL and oracle; historical evidence is retained unchanged.

uart_tx.timing_basis: 8N1 frame; accept E0, start/data/stop last 4 cycles each, busy clears at E40 and next acceptance can be E41. Budget permits multiple frames and reset/busy probes.

spi_master.timing_basis: Accept E0; toggle sclk once per busy cycle, update MOSI after rising sclk, finish E15 with done=1, restore idle sclk at E16. Existing RTL waveform contract, not a full standard SPI timing claim.

handshake_stage.timing_basis: One-entry elastic stage: pre-edge valid/ready determines transfer, blocked output holds, consume/refill can coincide, and in_ready is combinational.

prompt_profile.functional_coverage: available to single/feedback; no_feedback and feedback_no_coverage hidden
